title: Shocked Face Gaming Thumbnail
tests: Tests composing a generated face and exact three-word typography into one readable widescreen thumbnail.

judge.summary: A bright, punchy 16:9 thumbnail with a large shocked face on the right and a bold, clearly readable headline on the left.

must_haves.why: The image is a finished 1024×576 thumbnail in a 16:9 aspect ratio.

must_haves.item: A large, clearly visible human face on the right with a shocked expression.
must_haves.why: The right side features a prominent human face with wide eyes, raised eyebrows, and an open mouth.

must_haves.item: The headline reads exactly “ONE LAST TRY”, with no additional words.
must_haves.why: The only visible words are “ONE LAST TRY,” spelled correctly.

must_haves.item: The headline sits on the left, is high-contrast and does not cover the face.
must_haves.why: Large yellow and white lettering with thick dark outlines occupies the left side, clearly separated from the face.
